title: BYD Passed Tesla In Global EV Sales
hook: China's EV Maker Took The Lead
source: BYD's reported annual new-energy-vehicle sales (BEV + plug-in hybrid, via CnEVPost and BYD's own sales releases) vs. Tesla's annual global delivery totals (Tesla investor updates). 2018: BYD 247,811 NEVs vs Tesla 245,491 deliveries. BYD's NEV sales then pulled ahead through 2022-2025 (1.80M, 3.02M, 4.27M, 4.60M) while Tesla's deliveries plateaued and slipped (1.31M, 1.81M, 1.79M, 1.64M) — BYD's full-year sales topped Tesla's for the first time in 2023-2024, confirmed in BYD's 2024 annual report (CNN Business, CNBC, March 2025). Note: BYD's total includes plug-in hybrids; Tesla sells fully-electric only.
